question: > wha accounts have highest ARR?
sql: SELECT     end_user_name,     SUM(arr::NUMERIC) AS total_arr,     RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(arr::NUMERIC) DESC) AS rank,     ROUND(100.0 * SUM(arr::NUMERIC) / SUM(SUM(arr::NUMERIC)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total FROM data_arr WHERE fiscal_quarter = 'FY 2027 Q1' GROUP BY end_user_name ORDER BY total_arr DESC LIMIT 10;
